observations: body L5-L9: Schiaparelli's numbers agree: half the zone between the equator and the parallel of 60° is sin 60° : 4 = 0.8660 : 4 = 0.2165 of the sphere, against 1 : 12 = 0.0833, 2.6 times less.
body L10: «Schiaparelli» is set in small capitals; the closing bracket is printed heavy.
body L16: «exstantihus» is printed for exstantibus; kept as printed.
body L31: «aṭ-» at the end of the line is printed heavy, like bold.
notes_right L1: in «al-Ḫuwârizmî» the H carries a breve below and the vowels circumflexes, as in the title of Nallino's memoir; the last letter is blotted.
source_authority: Controlling master page image. Embedded text is not the authority for a reading.
transcription_convention: Source line breaks, hyphenation, quotation signs and word-level type distinctions retained. L numbers count text-bearing lines.
review_responsibility: Transcribed by Claude from the page images; Greek, Arabic, numbers and signs read on enlarged images. Not reviewed by a person.
